record.paper_title: AUTOMORPHISMS AND DYNAMICS: A LIST OF OPEN PROBLEMS
record.context_brief: Comparing real and complex dynamics on K3 surfaces
record.original_question: Does there exist a real projective K3 surface X_R with an automorphism f: X_R → X_R such that λ_1(f) > 1, the real locus X(R) is nonempty, and at least one of the following holds: (1) the topological entropy of f on X(R) equals the topological entropy of f on X(C); (2) the entropy of f on some connected component S of X(R) is zero; or (3) some connected component S of X(R) is contained in the Fatou set of f?

evidence.quote: Question 3.5. Does there exist a real projective K3 surface XR with an automorphism f : XR → XR such that λ1(f) > 1, X(R) is not empty, and one of the following propery occurs (1) the entropy of f on X(R) is equal to the entropy of f on X(C) ? (2) the entropy of f on some component S of X(R) vanishes ? (3) a connected component S of X(R) is contained in the Fatou set of f ?

artifact.category_tag: Real K3 surface automorphisms and entropy
artifact.status_search_result: A recent 2025 construction exhibits a real K3 automorphism for which the real topological entropy is more than half the complex entropy, settling a closely related question. However, the three specific cases asked about (equality of real and complex entropies, vanishing entropy on a real component, or a real component lying in the Fatou set) are explicitly noted as not resolved, so the question appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: A real K3 automorphism with most of its entropy in the real part
status_evidence.snippet: the purpose of this paper is to provide such an example where 2 h_top(f, X(R)) > h_top(f, X(C)); cases with 0 = h_top(f, X(R)) < h_top(f, X(C)) or 0 < h_top(f, X(R)) = h_top(f, X(C)) are not resolved
status_evidence.claim: The three sub-cases of the question remain open as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: Geometry and dynamics on Riemann and K3 surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Cantat noted that much is unknown about how the real topological entropy and complex topological entropy might compare on K3 surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Cantat highlights the comparison between real and complex entropy as open.
